title: etw: Add WebIO (WinHTTP) provider
description:
In addition to the scenario to capture [WinInet](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/win32/wininet/about-wininet) (e.g. the windows store, windows defender, etc.), add a scenario to capture [WinHTTP](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/win32/winhttp/about-winhttp) which is the second main HTTP library on Windows (e.g. winget, WinRM, etc.). This one is new compared to MMA.

AI-Assisted: no
